name: CYT (55 / 57, no checksum): any car (raw messages)
description: CYT box whose frames have no head and no checksum: CMD LEN data, CMD 55 or 57 (both ways). Read from Car Info's decoders CytFordProtocol and CytAirFordProtocol (their deframer, parsePacket). No acknowledgement. Any car: no decoding, raw messages. Also the description of this box type ("box": "cyt-55").
